## App Submission — SideStack Store

**Please fill out every field completely. Submissions with missing or incomplete information will be closed without review.**

---

### App Name
<!-- The full name of your app as it should appear in the store -->

### Short Description / Tagline
<!-- One sentence that describes what your app does -->

### Raw Config URL
<!-- The raw GitHub URL to your docs/config.json file -->
<!-- Example: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YOU/YOUR-REPO/main/docs/config.json -->

### App Repo URL
<!-- Link to the public GitHub repository for your app -->

### Developer GitHub Username
<!-- Your GitHub username -->

### Latest Version
<!-- The current version of your app (e.g. 1.0.0) -->

### Supported Architectures
<!-- e.g. arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64 -->

### Minimum Android Version
<!-- e.g. Android 8.0 (API 26) -->

### App Category / Tags
<!-- e.g. Utilities, Media, Tools -->

### Checklist
- [ ] My `docs/config.json` is publicly accessible at the URL provided above
- [ ] My app has a public GitHub release with APK(s) attached
- [ ] I generated my app page using the SideStack Release Tool
- [ ] All fields in this submission are filled out completely and accurately
